nodes.name: Urea hydrolysis NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: Synthesis of NiFe-CO3 LDH by urea hydrolysis method using Ni2+, Fe3+ with NO3- ions in NO3::Urea molar ratio = 1:4 under hydrothermal condition at 110°C for 24h (Table 2, entry 1, ref 78).

nodes.name: Chelated urea hydrolysis NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: Synthesis of [Ni0.75Fe0.25(OH)2](CO3)0.13·0.5H2O using trisodium citrate (TSC) as chelating agent and urea as precipitant, followed by hydrothermal treatment at 150°C for 2 days (Table 2, entry 2, ref 76).
